title: The Ice Miner's Stipulation
logline: An ice harvester bequeaths his heavy core drill to his estranged daughter on the strict condition that she deliver an uninspected water load to a destitute off-grid squatters' rock.

roles.description: Inheritor of an ice-drilling skiff; debt-burdened, bitter about her father's lifelong absence, forced to execute his testamentary instructions.
Probate officer enforcing creditor claims on the estate; impatient, legalistic, eager to forfeit the vessel to commercial lenders.
An unmapped hollowed rock where off-grid outcasts ration stale air and recycled condensation.
The licensed municipal bulk water intake berth where commercial barges unload.

public_situation: An estate auction sign hangs over a veteran ice-drilling skiff at {role:ice_depot} while probate agents set a strict forty-eight hour claim deadline.
private_truth: The deceased harvester's testament grants the drill rig to {role:estranged_daughter} only if she delivers an unbilled bulk water cistern to {role:squatters_crag}.

beats.public_change: Notice boards at {role:ice_depot} announce that the harvester's estate must clear outstanding municipal dock fees before the will is read.

missions.reason: She hires an outside pilot to mine and deliver certified water ice to satisfy the probate court's filing fees before the vessel is auctioned.
missions.private_fact: She resentfully promised her dying father she would hear his will, despite not having spoken to him in eight years.

beats.public_change: The probate clerk unseals the codicil, demanding immediate transit certification before releasing the skiff's control codes.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to collect her father's sealed core-drill telemetry key from an impound locker before the liquidator locks the hatch.
missions.private_fact: Her father spent his last four years secretly pumping water to the unregistered squatter habitat without logging the extraction.

beats.public_change: The liquidator starts an automated countdown timer on the skiff's docking clamps, threatening immediate repossession.

missions.reason: She asks the pilot to courier the emergency bulk ice manifest and activation codes directly to the squatter elders to fulfill the condition.
missions.private_fact: She is torn between honoring her father's humanitarian debt and selling the vessel to pay off her own grinding debts.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at the squatter habitat as the probate timer counts down the final minutes on the drill rig's title.

options.label: Confirm the water delivery to the squatters and secure the daughter's title
Divert the water to the commercial market to clear the daughter's personal debts
Surrender the drill rig to the station liquidator to take a broker finder fee

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot confirms the delivery to the squatter crag and files the fulfillment certificate.
resolutions.summary: The squatters receive critical water reserves. {role:estranged_daughter} inherits her father's drill rig and assumes his quiet humanitarian trade.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an estranged daughter deliver water to forgotten squatters to claim her father's drill rig.

resolutions.reached_by: The water is diverted and sold at commercial market rates to pay off personal liabilities.
resolutions.summary: The water is sold to commercial depots. The testamentary condition fails, but {role:estranged_daughter} clears her personal debt while {role:squatters_crag} goes dry.

resolutions.reached_by: The deadline lapses or the vessel is surrendered to satisfy commercial mortgages.
resolutions.summary: {role:station_liquidator} auctions the drill rig to corporate water cartels. {role:estranged_daughter} walks away penniless, and the squatters are left parched.

loose_threads.detail: The drill rig's mortgage deed was transferred to an unlisted private debt fund forty-eight hours before the father died.
The squatter cistern collars are stamped with emergency aid serial numbers assigned to an expedition that vanished a decade ago.

radio_hooks: Probate court sets expedited auction timetable for default mining hardware.
Outer rock settlements report critical water rationing as dry season begins.
Commercial water bulk prices climb steadily across orbital exchange boards.

voice_direction.estranged_daughter: Bitter, curt, and protective. Speaks with flat cadence and becomes guarded whenever family duty or charity is mentioned.
voice_direction.station_liquidator: Crisp, bureaucratic, and condescending. Recites statutory repayment paragraphs with cheerful indifference to personal tragedy.
